operators.name: paper.backend.mean_welch
operators.purpose: Welch comparison over supported independent time-block means.

implementation.semantics: Welch two-sample test over independent fixed-width time-block means; block means are the independent units.
reconstruction_assumptions: The paper does not specify this implementation equation or its parameter defaults.
Fixed-width UTC time blocks are treated as independent sampling units for the statistical tests.

operators.name: paper.backend.location_permutation
operators.purpose: Block permutation test for a declared location statistic.

implementation.semantics: Two-sided independent-block permutation test for mean difference.
reconstruction_assumptions: The paper does not specify this implementation equation or its parameter defaults.
Fixed-width UTC time blocks are treated as independent sampling units for the statistical tests.

operators.name: paper.backend.tail_permutation
operators.purpose: Block permutation test for a separately declared tail statistic.

implementation.semantics: Two-sided independent-block permutation test for a separately selected quantile difference.
reconstruction_assumptions: The paper does not specify this implementation equation or its parameter defaults.
Fixed-width UTC time blocks are treated as independent sampling units for the statistical tests.

operators.name: paper.events.outcome_support
operators.purpose: Aho-Corasick event-pattern support contrast between valid outcome groups.

implementation.reason: No event stream or valid success/failure outcome field is represented.
implementation.future_requirement: No event stream or valid success/failure outcome field is represented.

operators.name: paper.scores.dependency_adjust
operators.purpose: Adjust scores using supported trace-local dependency edges and corroborated anomalies.

implementation.semantics: Reconstruction: reduce a caller score only when an observed same-trace parent edge points to a child with eligible corroborating anomaly evidence; preserve source evidence unchanged.
reconstruction_assumptions: The paper does not publish the exact implementation equation or source code.

operators.name: paper.answers.weighted_consensus
operators.purpose: Normalize independent scorer votes and combine using explicit weights.

implementation.semantics: Normalize each scorer within its declared family, average scorer votes within family, apply caller-supplied family weights, and retain eligible evidence unchanged.
reconstruction_assumptions: The paper does not publish the exact implementation equation or source code.
